Joins Montgomery tracts with EPA facility counts and CDC PLACES adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, and returns the correlation and paired tract count ordered by facility density descending.
sql:
WITH facility_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(n AS INT)), 0) AS facility_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_4e3740' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
places AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_pct
  FROM session.fw_4e3740_m2_cdc
),
tract_data AS (
  SELECT t.geoid,
         t.name,
         f.facility_count,
         p.totalpopulation,
         p.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
         CASE WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
              THEN CAST(f.facility_count AS DOUBLE) / p.totalpopulation * 1000
         END AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN facility_counts f ON f.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN places p ON p.geoid = t.geoid
)
SELECT name,
       epa_facilities_per_1000_residents,
       adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
       facility_count,
       totalpopulation,
       CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_residents, adult_asthma_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS facility_asthma_correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM tract_data
WHERE epa_facilities_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL
  AND adult_asthma_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200
